chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: The Brooks family: Dudley, Bert and the bathhouse
summary: They sort out Dudley Brooks's brothers and recall that their father ran a bathhouse.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What about the Brooks family, Dudley Brooks and that gang?
Dudley? Well, yeah, let me tell you about Dudley.
Yeah.
Dudley, he took a little sick and wasnt very well, so Dudley quit playing, he quit playing.
You mean then. Now?
No, not Dudley. I'm thinking about his brother.
Bert?
No, not -- his brother.
Oh. Well, how many brothers did they have -- did Dudley have?
Dudley? He's had two brothers.
He's got Bert, -- and I didn't know the other one.
Saw Bert yesterday. And the other one was -- I can't think of the other brother's name.
Yeah. But, anyway, the other brother took sick, whatever his name is. We'll find that out.
Yeah.
Yeah. But Dudley, I guess, is okay. I haven't seen him in three or four months. He must be on a steady job.
Yeah, he must be.
Did you know the (inaudible) family? Was the father in music, too?
The father, Old Man Brook? No, I knew the father. He wasn't in music, he was in -- busy --
Business.
You know, business.
Bath house?
Yeah, bath house, that's right. How did you know?
Well, that's why I came in, (when inaudible), you guys were talking about Brook's Bathhouse.
Brook's Bathouse, yeah, sure.
